reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that connects Paper Plane X research context and paper search, allowing users to manage project context and insert selected paper IDs into prompts.

summaries.zh: 将 Paper Plane X 的研究上下文和论文检索接入 DeepSeek Harness Web，支持管理项目上下文并将选定论文引用到输入框。
summaries.en: Connects Paper Plane X research context and paper search to the DeepSeek Harness Web interface, enabling context management and insertion of selected paper IDs into prompts.

capabilities: Reads and updates Paper Plane X context through the ppx CLI and host endpoints
Searches Paper Plane X Librarian for papers by keyword or paper ID
Adds a selected paper ID to the DeepSeek Harness input
Provides a link to the configured Paper Plane X project page
